description: §5.2.3 (S435) — an inline block handler on a button inside an engine state-child's bare body runs both statements on click.
rationale: §5.2.3 (amended S435): "No statement of the block SHALL be dropped, whatever its kind or position — in particular, a statement's effect SHALL NOT depend on … whether the handler sits at top level, inside an engine state-child (§51.0.I), or inside an `<each>` row (§17.7)." One click: count 0 → 1, track sets last to "go".
